$comment: Prompts for this game's art: npm run gen:asset -- co-ca-ngua/<name> (the style in assets/prompts.json is added).

island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a colorful four-color race board game (red, blue, green, yellow paths) with a giant white dice with red dots and little horse-shaped game pieces. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.
